body_html:
DJ, Audio Engineer, & Event Specialist

Hailing from Virginia, Tyler S. brings a dynamic and versatile background to the world of entertainment. With experience in voiceover work for brands like Frito Lay and Defiant Recording Studios, Tyler’s career has always been rooted in creativity and connection. Drawn to DJing by his passion for music, culture, dancing, and the unforgettable memories created at every event, Tyler has mastered the art of crafting the perfect atmosphere for a truly memorable experience.

Known for his ability to energize the dance floor, Tyler’s favorite tracks include iconic hits like Single Ladies by Beyoncé, anything by Lady Gaga, Dolly Parton classics, and the timeless bangers of the 2000s. Whether spinning classics, contemporary hits, or exciting mashups, Tyler ensures that every guest feels the rhythm and joy of the moment.

Beyond DJing, Tyler is an accomplished audio engineer and radio show host, showcasing his expertise in sound and entertainment. In his spare time, he enjoys cooking, hiking, traveling, photography, writing poetry, and reading—passions that fuel his creativity and connection with people.

Tyler sees DJing and MCing not just as a job but as a true vocation. His approach combines professionalism, enthusiasm, and an innate ability to read the crowd, ensuring that everyone—from kids to grandparents—has an unforgettable time. Tyler’s talent for bridging generations with his music makes him the perfect choice for events of all kinds.

With his dedication, energy, and commitment to excellence, Tyler S. is ready to make your event spectacular, leaving your guests smiling, dancing, and talking about the celebration for years to come.
